truths.statement: The browser AI wrapper posts body.action to /api/chat whenever the call options include action.
say() forwards explicit action options to AI/AI.json, including agShape action ask and agName action name.
actionFromPrompt preserves existing ask, angle, collide and rewrite routing by deriving those action keys from current prompt text when callers do not pass an explicit action.

dont_assume: Frontend action routing exposes no model API keys; keys stay in backend model configuration.
The local Claude extension path may bypass /api/chat because action forwarding only applies to the API-backed AI wrapper.
